The '''Southern Mesas''' were a series of towers connected by bridges on the [[planet]] [[Mygeeto]]. During the [[Third Battle of Mygeeto]], [[Jedi General]] [[Depa Billaba]] and [[Padawan]] [[Kanan Jarrus|Caleb Dume]] were tasked with clearing the mesas of [[battle droid]]s.<ref name="Kanan 10" />
